segments.name: Americas ("AMS")
segments.description: Sells the Company's integrated flooring portfolio—modular carpet, LVT, rubber flooring and FLOR rugs—across the United States, Canada and Latin America.
segments.evidence: The AMS operating segment includes the United States, Canada and Latin America geographic areas.

segments.name: Europe, Africa, Asia and Australia
segments.description: Sells the same integrated flooring products as AMS within Europe, Africa, Asia and Australia.
segments.evidence: Our AMS and EAAA reportable segments sell the same products within their respective geographical regions.

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly in commercial and institutional end-markets, pay the Company for flooring products, largely made-to-order, plus installation products and turnkey flooring project management services.
revenueModel.evidence: While we continue to manufacture and sell a substantial portion of our carpet tile in standard styles, most of our modular carpet sales in the Americas and Asia-Pacific regions are made-to-order products designed to meet customer specifications.
